mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) reduce discount rates applied to equity cash flows, increasing equity attractiveness and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly higher (p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below the 25th percentile of its historical range compared to when it is above the 75th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly lower (p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% compared to when FEDFUNDS <= 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) combined with CPI exceeding 320 (CPIAUCSL) indicate monetary tightening with inflation, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL>320) does not produce significantly negative returns (p>0.05) compared to the baseline in the 20-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%) trigger Federal Reserve monetary easing, increasing equity attractiveness and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly higher (p>0.05) when UNRATE > 5.0% compared to when UNRATE <= 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1300.0 (HOUST) signal economic weakening and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly lower (p>0.05) when HOUST < 1300.0 compared to when HOUST >= 1300.0.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) levels indicate strong economic activity and robust corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly higher (p>0.05) when INDPRO is above the 75th percentile of its historical range compared to when it is below the 25th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: Residential sales falling below 700000.0 (RSAFS) indicate housing market contraction and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly lower (p>0.05) when RSAFS < 700000.0 compared to when RSAFS >= 700000.0.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly payroll growth falling below 159000.0 (PAYEMS) signals labor market weakness and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly lower (p>0.05) when PAYEMS < 159000.0 compared to when PAYEMS >= 159000.0.
